notes: This pure standard C++ scenario checks the joined-federate HLAobjectInstancesRemoved statistic through direct requests after an ordinary receive-order deletion and a periodic HLAsetTiming reflection. The scenario also verifies the matching application removal callback and the RTI-originated MOM reflection metadata. The baseline provider run is bounded evidence and does not establish provider-independent behavior or conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard MIM defines HLAobjectInstancesRemoved as the total Remove Object Instance service invocations for the represented joined federate since Join and declares the attribute periodic under HLAsetTiming. The scenario checks the direct value after an ordinary removal and verifies that the periodic reflection preserves the same count.
